selected_evidence.summary: Podman reports rootless=true; the recovered nginx process is owned by appsvc (UID 1000), whose password is locked and shell is /sbin/nologin.
Before and after reboot, the container published 0.0.0.0:8080, the listener was present, and http://10.100.10.10:8080 returned 'appsvc web application'.

selected_evidence.requirement: Starts at boot without an active login session
selected_evidence.summary: The Quadlet service is generated for boot, active after reboot, Linger=yes, and appsvc had zero active login sessions.

Healthy baseline used boot ID f38484ef-a289-4d30-9a94-4ab42c44f900; reboot scheduling was acknowledged; post-reboot boot ID changed to 4443a666-8166-406e-b066-b733c15ecd26; service, container, process ownership, port, login-session state, and HTTP data all recovered.
